name: js-shell-split
instruction: Implement shellSplit.js (CommonJS): module.exports = shellSplit. shellSplit(line) splits a command line into an argv array using POSIX-ish quoting: runs of whitespace separate arguments; single quotes are fully literal (a backslash inside them is literal too); double quotes preserve spaces but a backslash escapes only the characters \ " $ and ` inside them, and is otherwise literal; outside quotes a backslash escapes the next character. Adjacent quoted and unquoted runs join into ONE argument, and an empty quoted string produces an empty argument. An unterminated quote or a trailing backslash throws an Error.
